headline: Brazil President Lula Faces Spending Rows Over Fiscal Measures
summary: Brazilian President Lula is facing spending disputes as his supporters push back against stricter fiscal measures.
why: Fiscal policy discipline is closely monitored by credit rating agencies and international investors to gauge a country's debt sustainability and sovereign risk premium.
